Options positioning

From Cboe's free delayed option chains after the US close: open interest (settled, start of session) and closing prices. Gamma exposure assumes dealers hold the opposite side of customers who are long calls and long puts, a common simplification; it maps where hedging flows may cluster, not where price must go. S&P levels come from SPX options and are shifted to ES by the closing basis; gold levels come from GLD options scaled to the COMEX gold future. Not a live trade tape.

FX, gold and indices

Daily timeframe. Score 0-100 starts at 50 and adds four signals: day-on-day momentum (±12.5), RSI(14) (up to ±25), price vs 50-day EMA (±15) and 200-day Z-score (up to ±20); 60+ bullish, 40 or less bearish. Support and resistance: the 120-day high and low (strong) and levels 40% of the way from price to each (moderate). Same formula as the original FX Macro Confluence engine. Pairs from the ECB's official euro reference rates (daily 14:15 CET fixing, crossed through the euro; Yahoo then FRED as fallbacks); XAUUSD uses COMEX gold futures. ES, NQ and US30 are the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow 30 cash index levels from Yahoo Finance (FRED as fallback). Latest close 2026-10-23.

How to read this

Likely range this week is the 68% range (±1 sigma) from the last 20 and 60 days of price swings. In a 2001-2026 test on 7 pairs the weekly move stayed inside it 68.3% of weeks, so it is a size estimate you can rely on.

Macro lean counts the drivers that support the instrument higher or lower (a net of 2 is a lean). In the same test the read was right only about half of weeks, so treat it as background, not a signal. Crowded positioning (Z of 2 or more) and the risk or volatility rows are shown but not counted.

Confluence score (0-100) combines momentum, RSI, trend and Z-score; 60 or more reads bullish, 40 or less bearish. It also showed no reliable edge in the backtest.

Pairs use ECB reference rates, gold uses COMEX futures, indices are the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow 30 cash levels (Yahoo Finance, FRED as fallback). Latest close 2026-10-23. The chart shows % change from the start of the selected range.
